zh.title: 中央银行制度的转折
zh.description: 1907 年金融恐慌暴露了美国银行体系的脆弱性，推动了 1913 年美联储的建立。
zh.mechanism: 银行挤兑 → 信贷紧缩 → 改革货币制度
zh.lesson: 理解通胀，也要理解货币与银行制度。此时期尚无本项目的官方 CPI 观测值。

en.title: Before a new central bank
en.description: The Panic of 1907 exposed weaknesses in U.S. banking and helped motivate the creation of the Federal Reserve in 1913.
en.mechanism: Bank runs → tighter credit → monetary reform
en.lesson: The monetary system matters for understanding prices. This project has no official CPI observations for this era.

zh.title: 一战与价格上升
zh.description: 一战改变了贸易与融资。美国的黄金流入和货币扩张，与战时需求一起推动价格上涨。
zh.mechanism: 战争需求与融资 → 购买力增加 → 价格压力
zh.lesson: 战争冲击既影响供应，也改变支出和融资。

en.title: War and rising prices
en.description: World War I reshaped trade and finance. Gold inflows and monetary expansion accompanied wartime demand in the United States.
en.mechanism: War demand and finance → increased spending power → price pressure
en.lesson: War shocks affect both supply and the way spending is financed.

zh.title: 战后调整与恢复
zh.description: 美国在 1920 年收紧货币政策后经历衰退与价格下跌，随后在较低通胀环境中恢复。
zh.mechanism: 紧缩与需求回落 → 价格调整 → 经济恢复
zh.lesson: 通胀回落可能伴随经济代价，路径并不平稳。

en.title: Postwar adjustment
en.description: Following monetary tightening in 1920, the U.S. experienced recession and falling prices before recovering with relatively low inflation.
en.mechanism: Tightening and weaker demand → price adjustment → recovery
en.lesson: Disinflation can carry economic costs and need not follow a smooth path.

zh.title: 大萧条与通缩
zh.description: 银行危机、货币收缩与需求崩塌加深了大萧条。价格下跌也加重了实际债务负担。
zh.mechanism: 信贷与需求收缩 → 价格下跌 → 实际债务变重
zh.lesson: 价格下跌并不总是好消息，尤其当收入与就业也下滑时。

en.title: Depression and deflation
en.description: Banking distress, monetary contraction, and collapsing demand deepened the Depression. Falling prices increased real debt burdens.
en.mechanism: Credit and demand contract → prices fall → real debt burdens rise
en.lesson: Falling prices need not be good news when incomes and employment are falling too.

zh.title: 二战与战后通胀
zh.description: 战时融资与价格管制塑造了美国物价；战后解除管制和需求释放带来了新的价格压力。
zh.mechanism: 战争与管制 → 供需失衡 → 战后价格调整
zh.lesson: 管制下的价格不一定反映全部短缺压力。

en.title: War controls and postwar inflation
en.description: War finance and price controls shaped U.S. prices. Removing controls and releasing pent-up demand brought renewed pressure after the war.
en.mechanism: War and controls → supply-demand imbalances → postwar price adjustment
en.lesson: Controlled prices may not reveal the full pressure of shortages.

zh.title: 货币政策独立性
zh.description: 1951 年财政部与美联储达成协议，结束了战时形成的固定利率支持安排。
zh.mechanism: 财政融资需求 ↔ 货币政策目标
zh.lesson: 政策制度决定央行如何在融资、增长与物价之间作出选择。

en.title: Monetary policy independence
en.description: The 1951 Treasury–Fed Accord ended the wartime arrangement of supporting fixed interest rates.
en.mechanism: Public financing needs ↔ monetary policy goals
en.lesson: Policy institutions shape how central banks navigate financing, growth, and price stability.

zh.title: 大通胀与第一次石油冲击
zh.description: 美国通胀在 1960 年代中期开始走高。1973 年石油冲击叠加政策失误和不断变化的预期，令问题更加复杂。
zh.mechanism: 需求与政策压力 + 能源冲击 + 预期
zh.lesson: 滞胀不能只用一个油价因素解释。

en.title: The Great Inflation and oil
en.description: U.S. inflation rose from the mid-1960s. The 1973 oil shock compounded policy errors and shifting expectations.
en.mechanism: Demand and policy pressures + energy shock + expectations
en.lesson: Stagflation cannot be explained by oil prices alone.

zh.title: 第二次油价冲击与沃尔克紧缩
zh.description: 新的能源冲击之后，美联储转向更紧缩的政策。通胀最终下降，但期间经历了严重衰退。
zh.mechanism: 政策紧缩 → 融资和需求降温 → 通胀下降
zh.lesson: 抑制通胀存在时滞，也可能影响就业和产出。

en.title: Oil shock and Volcker tightening
en.description: After another energy shock, the Fed adopted tighter policy. Inflation eventually fell, with severe recessions along the way.
en.mechanism: Policy tightening → cooler financing and demand → lower inflation
en.lesson: Reducing inflation takes time and may affect jobs and output.

zh.title: 大缓和时期
zh.description: 许多发达经济体的通胀和产出波动下降。更好的政策、结构变化与较温和冲击的作用仍有争论。
zh.mechanism: 政策与结构变化 → 波动减小
zh.lesson: 低波动并不意味着金融风险已经消失。

en.title: The Great Moderation
en.description: Inflation and output became less volatile in many advanced economies. The roles of policy, structural change, and milder shocks remain debated.
en.mechanism: Policy and structural changes → lower volatility
en.lesson: Lower macroeconomic volatility does not eliminate financial risk.

zh.title: 金融危机后的低通胀
zh.description: 金融危机冲击信贷与需求。央行降息并购买资产，试图支持经济恢复。
zh.mechanism: 金融冲击 → 支出收缩 → 政策支持
zh.lesson: 资产购买与消费者价格之间并不存在固定比例关系。

en.title: Low inflation after the crisis
en.description: The financial crisis damaged credit and demand. Central banks cut rates and purchased assets to support recovery.
en.mechanism: Financial shock → weaker spending → policy support
en.lesson: Asset purchases do not translate into consumer prices at a fixed ratio.

zh.title: 疫情、通胀上升与回落
zh.description: 疫情后的供给受限和需求变化，叠加能源与食品冲击，推动通胀上升。随后供应恢复与货币紧缩共同推动通胀回落。
zh.mechanism: 供应与需求冲击 → 通胀上升 → 供应恢复与紧缩
zh.lesson: 通胀放缓是价格涨得更慢，不一定是价格回到从前。

en.title: Pandemic inflation and disinflation
en.description: Supply constraints and demand shifts after the pandemic combined with energy and food shocks. Supply recovery and monetary tightening later helped inflation fall.
en.mechanism: Supply and demand shocks → higher inflation → recovery and tightening
en.lesson: Disinflation means prices rise more slowly, not necessarily that prices return to earlier levels.

zh.title: 阅读当下，先核对数据
zh.description: 本项目以已发布的月度 CPI 观察价格变化。2026 年尚未结束，不能把已发布月份称为全年结果。
zh.mechanism: 核对月份与口径 → 区分价格水平和涨幅 → 再解释原因
zh.lesson: 单一 CPI 指标不足以判断所有通胀成因，也不足以预测未来。

en.title: Read the present with care
en.description: This project uses released monthly CPI observations. Because 2026 is not complete, available months are not a full-year outcome.
en.mechanism: Check dates and definitions → separate levels from rates → investigate causes
en.lesson: One CPI series cannot identify every inflation driver or predict the future.
